heading: Branding
secondaryText: Publish the app brand designed in ESP RainMaker Neo App Studio. Phones download it the next time ESP RainMaker Home opens and show it from the launch after.

form.fileDescription: Save the project in ESP RainMaker Neo App Studio and upload the .rainmaker file it downloads.

errors.fileRequired: Choose a .rainmaker file saved from App Studio.
errors.notRainmaker: This is not a .rainmaker file saved from App Studio.
errors.noBrand: This file has no app brand. Save the project again in App Studio and upload the new file.
errors.invalidBrand: The brand in this file is not valid ({{detail}}).
errors.invalidImage: An image in this file cannot be used ({{detail}}).
errors.tooLarge: The brand is larger than 32 KB. Remove some customisation and try again.
errors.publishFailed: Could not publish the brand. Try again.

form.published: {{brandName}} is published. Phones download it the next time ESP RainMaker Home opens and show it from the launch after.

empty: No brand is published, so ESP RainMaker Home shows its default look on this deployment.
loadError: Could not load the published brand
loadErrorDescription: Reload the page to try again.

errors.unavailable: This deployment does not allow branding from the dashboard yet. Redeploy it and try again.

delete.confirmDescription: Phones pick this up the next time ESP RainMaker Home opens and go back to its default look from the launch after.
delete.success: Brand deleted. Phones go back to the default look from the launch after they next open the app.
delete.failed: Could not delete the brand. Try again.

logo.heading: Logo
logo.secondaryText: The logo on the app's background in each mode it ships.

colors.heading: Colours
colors.secondaryText: The palette the app uses in place of its default colours, per mode.

icons.heading: Icons
icons.secondaryText: Device icons, AI agent icons and screen illustrations that replace the app's own.

wording.heading: Wording
wording.secondaryText: Words the app uses in place of its own.
